translate.title: Translate to English
translate.description: Translate speech from other languages to English while transcribing.

holdToTalk.title: Hold the main shortcut to record
holdToTalk.description: When off, press once to start and once to stop.

folder.title: App folder location
folder.description: Where models, recordings and settings are stored.

clipboard.title: Clipboard content
clipboard.description: What stays in the clipboard after the text is pasted.

paste.title: Paste result text
paste.description: Insert the text into the active app. When off, the text only goes to history and the clipboard.

autoSend.title: Auto-send after paste
autoSend.description: Press a key after pasting, to send a message right away.

simulate.title: Simulate keypresses
simulate.description: Type the text key by key instead of pasting. Slower, but works in apps that block paste.

trailingSpace.title: Append trailing space
trailingSpace.description: Add a space after the pasted text.

startHidden.title: Start hidden
startHidden.description: Launch in the menu bar without opening the window.

trayIcon.title: Show menu bar icon
trayIcon.description: Show the WhisperSM icon in the menu bar / system tray.

silenceRemoval.title: Silence removal
silenceRemoval.description: Drop silent parts before transcribing. Faster and fewer hallucinations.

playback.title: Playback when recording
playback.description: What happens to other audio while you record.

alwaysOn.title: Always-on microphone
alwaysOn.description: Keep the microphone open for a faster start.

output.title: Output device
output.description: Device used to play sound effects.

status.needsKey: Add an API key for {{provider}} to use this model

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys are stored on this computer and only sent to the provider you chose. Every provider listed has a free tier.

confirm.deleteActive: {{model}} is your active voice model. Deleting it stops dictation until you pick another one. Continue?

toasts.enabled: {{model}} can now be used in modes

custom.title: Custom language model
custom.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM…).
